purpose: Canonical machine-readable handover for the full-text acquisition pathway from corpus DOI records through OpenAlex content, GROBID/PDF selection, GitHub checkpointing, private Zenodo storage, and provenance registry.

corpus_audit.selection_rule: GROBID first; PDF only when no GROBID is available for the DOI/OpenAlex work

doi_lineage.basis: LivingEvidenceMap corpus DOI records followed by OpenAlex metadata/content audit
doi_lineage.matching_requirement: doi_exact_match == TRUE plus corresponding OpenAlex content availability
doi_lineage.historical_manual_sets: The exact DOI lists used for the earliest manually initiated batches are not preserved as a dedicated permanent file in the current repository. Do not invent them; use historical Actions artifacts/manifests or Git history if exact reconstruction is required.

batch_plan.openalex_content_cost_basis: 0.01 USD per content file as documented in repository at snapshot

download_logic.pdf_only_condition: doi_exact_match == TRUE AND has_pdf == TRUE AND DOI not already in GROBID set
download_logic.formats: GROBID TEI XML preferred; PDF fallback
download_logic.validation: PDF magic bytes or TEI marker; gzip GROBID responses supported
download_logic.retry_strategy: exponential backoff for transient HTTP/network failures

checkpointing.per_file: downloaded files are validated and manifest is updated during the batch

registry.individual_source_provenance: notes field records GROBID source filename such as W4205942496.tei.xml
registry.role: bridge between individual DOI/OpenAlex works and Zenodo batch/archive provenance

resume_protocol: Inspect current workflow and downloader rather than relying on historical descriptions
Inspect Actions artifacts/runs for incomplete batches
Only then continue or repair acquisition
important_limits: Exact early manually supplied DOI lists are not preserved as a dedicated repository file.
Zenodo record IDs represent batch storage, not individual papers.
Individual-paper provenance must be resolved through DOI/OpenAlex ID and the batch registry/source filename.
Do not assume the older docs/openalex_fulltext.md trigger description is current; inspect .github/workflows/openalex_fulltext_download.yml because the workflow later acquired a daily schedule.
